data.name: Emilianus
data.gender_notes: Emilianus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Emilius', meaning 'rival' or 'emanation from Aemilius'. In Christianity, Emilianus refers to a saint and martyr. The name is derived from the Latin word 'emilianus', meaning 'emperor's servant'. The name Emilianus carries the meaning “Emperor's servant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emilianus usually hope their child will grow to embody emperor's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A devotion to service and loyalty to one's emperor or higher power.
data.etymology: Emilianus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Emperor's servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emilianus total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אמיליאנוס
in_hebrew.meaning: אמיליאנוס הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו מתחרה או יריב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אמיליאנוס הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'מתחרה' או 'יריב'. השם נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'aemulus', שפירושה קנאי או מתחרה. השם אמיליאנוס היה נפוץ בכנסייה הנוצרית המוקדמת, והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית הקשורה לתחרות רוחנית ולמאבק למען האמונה.

in_greek.name: Ἐμιλιανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐμιλιανός, ὁ Ἐμιλιανός, εἰς τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν τῶν Χριστιανῶν ἀπὸ τῶν πρὸς τῆς ἀρχαίας Λατινικῆς ὀνομάστηκε διὰ τὸν ἀμφισβήτησιν ἤ ἀντιζηλίαν. Ἡ προέλευσις τοῦ οὔτοματος ἐστι ἀπὸ τὸ 'aemulus', ὃ σημαίνει ζηλωτής ἤ ἀντίζηλος.

in_latin.name: Emilianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Emilianus, nomen Christianum, originem ducit a lingua Latina. Nomen est derivatum a voce 'aemulus', quae significat aemulum vel rivalem. Emilianus in Ecclesia Christiana primitiva frequenter usurpatus est, et significationem spiritualem habet quae ad contentionem spiritualem et certamen pro fide pertinet.

It symbolizes a person who is ambitious, driven, and striving for excellence in their spiritual journey. The name has been used across various Christian cultures and is associated with positive personality traits such as determination and perseverance.
